name: Real Power
source:
In a world where heroines, and super powers exist; you are a meta-engineer that, by accident, gets their hands on a weapon capable of actually changing the system. For better or worse that's your decission to make. The weapon is capable of changing people, their thoughts, feelings and who they are as a whole. Become a super villain, a self serving hero, a revolutionary, or a little bit of everything. Whatever you choose, one thing is certain, the people that created the weapon want it back, and you dead. Make allies or force them into your cause, as you are thrown into a world much darker than it pretends to be. And have fun while you're at it.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/exerBastion]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是一个女英雄与超能力并存的世界。你是一名元工程师，意外得到一件能够真正改变世界规则的武器。无论选择让世界变好还是变坏，都由你决定。这件武器能够改变他人，包括他们的思想、感受乃至整个身份。成为超级反派、只顾自己的英雄、革命者，或者兼具几种身份。无论你如何选择，有一件事是确定的：创造这件武器的人想把它夺回去，还想要你的命。你可以结交盟友，也可以逼迫他们加入你的事业；与此同时，你也被抛入一个比表面阴暗得多的世界。尽情享受吧。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/exerBastion]Patreon[/url]]
